title: Rav Ada bar Ahavah (III)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman describes him as Rav Papa’s student, citing Chullin 133b, where he acted as an interpreter before Rav Papa. In Sanhedrin 36a he said: “From the days of Rabbi until Rav Ashi we do not find Torah and greatness in one place.” But in Gittin 59a the reading is Rav Acha son of Rava.
